title: Transition press results
hypothesis: Naming warps the model was not shown (258d: it never learned it went downstairs), moves made by scripts and conversations that start over stops the model misreading where it is and re-talking to the same character, so more runs leave the player house with the clock set and enter the rival house within the same budget.
notes: Pending, not queued. Activation PLAYER_HOUSE_ENTERED: the first door warp and the 1F/2F stairs (where 258d lost the floor change) are the first ordinary warps, Mom walks the player in by script on entry, and her conversations are the first ones the model restarts. The truck exit before it is a scripted map load the model does not press through. Needs press-result-v1 (ON in the incumbent).
